name: journey_brief
description: THE FASTEST PATH TO AN ANSWER. Give it a six-character booking reference (PNR) from the caller's boarding pass and it returns their whole journey checked against every live source at once: transit rules for their route, disruption at their destination, entry paperwork, where the aircraft physically is, and Dubai weather. Call this FIRST whenever the caller offers a booking reference — it replaces four separate tool calls. Read `headline` first, then `next_action`. `clear_to_travel` false means do not send them to the airport. If `advisory_changed_recently` is true, mention it. NOTE: the booking lookup itself is demo data (`booking_source: demo_booking`) — never invent passenger details beyond what is returned, but every check in `checks` is live.

pnr.description: Six-character booking reference / record locator, e.g. K7X2M9. Strip spaces; callers often spell it out letter by letter.
